name: Hadal-Dolina
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.
Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
